title: Get Top-Down Ownership

description:
Who owns an organization: one row per owner, however many chains of shareholdings
reach it, with the share it carries in the organization summed over every chain, the
chain carrying the most, and its flags. Polixis reports only the share on each link: this
MCP computes the effective share from them. `total_by_risk` counts the flagged owners of the
whole tree by marker, and the first page lists up to 25 of them, the sanctioned first; the
others carry their flags on their own rows.

Rows come largest effective share first, so a threshold question such as "who holds 25%
or more" is settled once the shares fall below it: stop there rather than reading every
page, unless `total_share_unknown` counts owners not yet read, whose share may be higher.
When `next_cursor` is set, pass it back as `cursor` for the next page.

cursor.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page, to get the next one. Pass it alone: it carries every argument of the first call, and the others are ignored.

page_size.description: At most this many rows on a page. Leave it out: a page then holds as many of the ranked rows as fit in about 8,000 tokens.

pid.description: The entity's pid, from `search_entities`, or one the user gave once `resolve_permanent_id` confirmed it. Required unless `cursor` is.

name: get_ultimate_beneficial_owners

outputSchema.description: The entities of an ownership tree, the largest effective share first, one page of them.

items.description: An entity in the ownership tree, with every chain that reaches it added up.

alerts.description: Alert categories, such as STATECO or RESTRICTION.

chains.description: How many distinct chains of links reach it.

depth.description: Fewest links from the entity asked about: 1 is direct.

direct_share_percent.description: The share across its own direct link with the entity asked about; null when it has none or Polixis reports no share.

effective_share_percent.description: Computed by this MCP, not sent by Polixis, which reports only the share on each link: the shares along each chain between it and the entity asked about multiplied together (50% of 60% is 30%), then summed over the chains. A chain with a link that reports no share is left out. For owners it is the share it holds, for holdings the share held in it. Null when no chain reports a share on every link. Call it a figure derived from Polixis's link shares, not Polixis's own.

end_of_chain.description: Whether nothing lies beyond it: for owners, no owner of its own is known, as for an ultimate beneficial owner; for holdings, it holds nothing further. A tree cut short by Polixis may hide more.

flags.description: Such as SANCTION, PEP or REP.

name.description: Its name, in English where Polixis has one.

pid.description: The entity's pid.

roles.description: Its roles across its links, such as shareholder.

share_unknown_on_some_chain.description: Whether a chain to it has a link without a share, so the true effective share may be higher.

strongest_chain.description: The chain carrying the largest share, from the link next to the entity asked about to this entity.

items.description: One link of an ownership chain.

name.description: Its name, null when Polixis gives none.

pid.description: The entity at this link.

share_percent.description: The share across this link, with the link before it or, for the first, with the entity asked about; null when Polixis reports none.

flagged.description: At most 25 flagged entities of the whole tree, the sanctioned first, then in the order of the rows; on the first page only, empty on the others. When `total_flagged` is larger, the rest carry their flags on their entity rows, further down the pages.

items.description: A flagged entity of the tree, wherever its rows fall.

depth.description: Fewest links from the entity asked about.

effective_share_percent.description: As on its entity row: computed by this MCP from the link shares, not sent by Polixis; null when no chain reports a share on every link.

name.description: Its name, null when Polixis gives none.

pid.description: The entity's pid.

risks.description: Its risk markers: the flags SANCTION, PEP, FORMER_PEP or REP, and the alert categories SANCTION, SANCTIONTERRITORY, RESTRICTION or STATECO (state-owned or -controlled).

next_cursor.description: Pass it as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

pid.description: The entity asked about.

total_by_risk.description: How many of the flagged entries, across every page, carry each risk marker. Every marker is listed, so a 0 settles that none carries it without reading the other pages.

total_flagged.description: Flagged entities in the whole tree.

total_share_unknown.description: Entities across every page with `share_unknown_on_some_chain`, whose true share may be higher than shown. Those with no known share at all come last, so shares falling below a threshold settle it only once every one of these has been read.

truncated_by_polixis.description: Whether Polixis cut the tree at its cap of 300 nodes per level or 5,000 in all, so even every page together is not the whole tree. Start again from a sub-holding.

title: Get Ultimate Beneficial Owners

description: Checks a pid the user already holds, such as one stored in a client file. Call it first whenever the user gives a pid rather than a name. `status` is `active` when the pid is current: use it as it is. It is `merged` when Polixis merged the entity into another, whose pid is `redir`: use that one, and tell the user to update their records. It is `never minted` when Polixis does not know the pid: say so, describe no entity, and find the client again by name or identifier. A 410 error means the pid named a group Polixis dissolved, and lists its former members.

pid.description: The pid to check: P, O or U, then 32 hex digits.

name: resolve_permanent_id

redir.description: The pid a merged pid now points to.

title: Resolve Permanent Id

description:
Find organizations and people in Polixis by name or identifier, with their sanctions and
PEP flags, dates, countries and identifiers to tell matches apart.

Call it first when you have a name or identifier: every other Polixis tool takes a match's
`pid`. When the user gives a pid instead, call `resolve_permanent_id` with it. A match may
not show that a person is a former PEP: before saying a person is not a PEP, read the
`flags` of `get_entity_profiles`, which show FORMER_PEP. When `next_cursor` is set, more
matches exist: pass it back as `cursor` to page through them.

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes, such as `ch`. A match needs only one of them.

cursor.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page, to get the next one. Pass it alone: it carries every argument of the first call, and the others are ignored.

dates.description: Dates such as a birth or registration date, as YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM or YYYY. A match needs one of its dates within one of them. Polixis filters on it, so it narrows a common name better than comparing the matches yourself.

entity_type.description: Only organizations or only people. Leave it out for both.

name.description: A name, registration number, LEI or ISIN of an organization or person. Required unless `cursor` is given.

page_size.description: Matches per page, at most 10, which come to about 8,000 tokens. Polixis pages them itself.

name: search_entities

outputSchema.description: One page of matches, best first: exact matches, then fuzzy ones.

items.description: An organization or person the search matched.

alerts.description: Risk and status alerts, as Polixis words them.

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes of its countries.

dates.description: Dates by kind, such as Date of Birth or Registration Date, as YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM or YYYY when that is all Polixis knows.

entity_type.description: PERSON or ORGANIZATION; vessels and aircraft are organizations.

identifiers.description: Identifiers by type, such as registration numbers, LEIs or tax ids.

name.description: Its current name, in English where Polixis has one.

name_count.description: How many distinct names and spellings Polixis holds for it, of which `name_records` and `other_names` list ten at most.

name_records.description: Its first ten typed names, with the original script.

items.description: A name the entity is known by, with its kind and original script.

kind.description: Such as CURRENT_NAME, FORMER_NAME, TRADE_NAME or ALIAS.

language.description: ISO 639-1 code of the original name.

original.description: The name as written in its own script; null when it is `name` itself.

other_names.description: Spellings Polixis lists that no name record holds, as many as fit in the ten names listed.

pid.description: Polixis' permanent id, which every other Polixis tool takes as `pid`.

politically_exposed.description: Whether Polixis flags it as a PEP. It may be false for a former PEP, whom the `flags` of `get_entity_profiles` mark FORMER_PEP.

sanction_statuses.description: Sanctions list name to its status, ACTIVE or DELISTED.

sanctioned.description: Whether Polixis flags it for sanctions exposure.

next_cursor.description: Pass it as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

total_matches.description: Matches across every page, or null when Polixis does not say.
